name: Song radio
description: One click builds a genuinely related queue: the seed artist plus similar artists' most-listened tracks, weighted to your favorites and deduped against recent plays, and plays it. A real fix for Qobuz's weak autoplay. Radio button on the player bar for what's playing, or right-click any track to start from that song. Each radio is saved as a real private playlist named "Qobuzify Radio" in your Qobuz library, replaced by the next one.
author: matthewprince
